item.title: HTTP Caching, a Refresher
item.description:
📝 Cache-Control response directives max-age=<number> The max-age response directive defines the response’s freshness timeline in seconds, after which the response should be considered stale. 1 must-revalidate The must-revalidate response directive indicates that the cache must not reuse a stale response until it’s been successfully validated by the origin server. 2 If the server throws an error, the cache must surface that instead of reusing a stale response.
🔗 Read more: https://danburzo.ro/http-caching-refresher/

item.title: An initial analysis of the discovered Unix V4 tape
item.description:
📝 The Fourth Research Edition Unix came out of the famous AT&T Bell Laboratories in November 1973. Some have claimed that the tape’s contents are very close to the Fifth Edition rather to what really was the Fourth Edition. This shows that 52 thousand lines of the Fourth Edition are indeed part of the Fifth Edition, but the Fifth Edition also introduces about eleven new thousand lines of code.
🔗 Read more: https://www.spinellis.gr/blog/20251223/?yc261223
